title: apply_discount returns the wrong price
provenance: synthetic issue against the demo repo examples/repos/shop (the bug is real: apply_discount(100, 10) returns 0.0)

claims.repro:
from shop.billing import apply_discount

assert apply_discount(100, 10) == 90.0, apply_discount(100, 10)
claims.quote: `apply_discount()` in `shop/billing.py` returns 0.0 for a 10% discount on 100 instead of 90.0.
